title: time signal
description: Clock tick generated by the trusted runtime page itself (runtime/host.js startSignals), not by the server. Sent once per second (1 Hz). No network access, no provider. Not sensitive.

now.description: Current time in Unix epoch MILLISECONDS (Date.now()).

locale.description: BCP 47 locale the user chose in theme.locale; 'auto' is resolved to navigator.language before the first tick (e.g. 'ja-JP', 'en-GB').

hour12.description: theme.hour12: true when the user prefers a 12-hour clock.

tz.description: IANA time zone of the machine (Intl resolvedOptions().timeZone), e.g. 'Asia/Tokyo'.
